body: Greg's direction, relayed by Engram::Advisor in TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #916 (2026-10-16 21:41:16Z), verbatim: "Greg direction: create new coding/implementation sessions with TermAl auto-approve mode enabled, so routine MCP prompts do not park a lane. Apply it to future eligible sessions and record the effective mode in the dispatch. This does not broaden task scope, commit/push/restart authority, or permit unapproved external actions. For already-created Codex 7305, do not assume this changes its pending prompt; Greg will handle/cancel it in UI." How to apply: whenever a TermAl coordinator or worker creates a NEW coding or implementation session (termal_spawn_session or a root created for a lane), enable TermAl's auto-approve mode if the tool offers it, and state the effective approval mode in the dispatch message and the item note. Read-only reviewer children keep writePolicy readOnly; this doesn't change that, and it widens no other authority. Existing sessions are unchanged.
